caption:
Oven on before the onions

Oven first, then the onions: my aunt's one kitchen rule. Dinner stopped waiting on the oven.

An oven needs a head start, and everything you chop or stir fits inside that wait.

For whoever turns the oven on before touching the recipe.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

The text stays: me turning the oven on first.
